airzone_management.intro: Organise names, rooms and visibility in Moli. These local changes do not send any commands to Airzone equipment.
airzone_management.name: Name in Moli
airzone_management.label_help: These labels only change in Moli. The Airzone name and stable identifier are preserved.
airzone_management.blank_help: Up to 60 characters per field. Leave a field blank to use the value provided by Airzone, if available.
airzone_management.confirm_help: The device remains available here for reading and can be shown again. Hiding does not unpair it or delete its history or automations. Existing automations keep running.
airzone_management.awaiting_pin: Confirm your access in the Moli code window to continue. Your input is preserved.
airzone_management.success.labels_saved: The name and room have been saved in Moli.
airzone_management.success.hidden_saved: The device is hidden in Moli. It remains available in this list.
airzone_management.success.restored: The device is visible in Moli again.
airzone_management.error.invalid: Check the name and room: up to 60 characters per field.
airzone_management.error.auth: Access was denied. Your input is preserved; check your permissions before trying again.
airzone_management.error.auth_busy: Another approval is already open. Complete it, then try again. Your input is preserved.
airzone_management.error.cancelled: Approval was cancelled. Your input is preserved.
airzone_management.error.network: Moli could not confirm the save. Your input is preserved; check the connection before trying again.
airzone_management.error.server: Moli refused the save. Your input is preserved; you can try again.
airzone_management.error.response: Moli’s response does not confirm the save. Your input is preserved; check the current state before trying again.
airzone_management.error.missing: This device is no longer available. No further changes can be saved.
airzone_management.error.rate_limit: Too many changes at once. Wait a moment before trying again; your input is preserved.
airzone_management.error.connection: The connection to Moli has been lost. Information remains available for reading; saving will be available after reconnection, when you request it.
airzone_management.error.refresh: The change was saved, but the view could not be refreshed. Reload the page to see the new state.
